name: No volver a contactar
trigger: The customer asks not to be called, contacted, messaged or bothered again.
content:
1. Immediately call [tool id="${tool:register_opt_out}" name="register_opt_out"]. Do not ask for a reason, do not try to persuade them, and do not require identity verification first.
2. Confirm in one sentence that ${tenant_name} will not contact them again for collections, as [kb id="${kb:ley_2300}" name="Ley 2300 de 2023"] allows them to request.
3. If the result says linked_to_account is false, offer once, in one short sentence, to confirm their identity so the request is applied to their records. Do not mention a debt, credit, loan or account while doing it. If they accept, run [procedure id="${procedure:verificacion_identidad}" name="Verificación de identidad"] and then call register_opt_out again. If they decline, respect it.
4. Mention they can still reach ${tenant_name} through its official channels whenever they want to pay or ask something.
5. Close the call with [system_tool id="end_call" name="End call"] once they have no more questions.
